films.title: Creature Comforts
films.synopsis: Zoo animals speak in real British interview voices about housing, weather, and captivity. Nick Park’s Oscar-winning clay short makes ordinary complaints feel handmade and dryly funny.
films.the_mood: Dry, gentle comedy with soft clay animals and the everyday awkwardness of being stuck somewhere that is not quite home.
films.notes: Aardman clay short for Clay Animation Movies guide cover.
